faqs.question: Is HubSpot CRM really free forever?
faqs.answer: Yes, HubSpot CRM is free with unlimited users, contacts, and basic features. You only pay when you need marketing automation, sales automation, or service tools. The free CRM is sufficient for most early-stage startups.

faqs.question: When should a startup switch from HubSpot to Salesforce?
faqs.answer: Switch when you have 20+ sales reps, need complex custom workflows, or require enterprise features like territory management and advanced forecasting. Most startups don't need Salesforce until Series B or beyond.

faqs.question: How much does Salesforce cost for a 10-person startup?
faqs.answer: Salesforce Essentials costs /month (10 x ). HubSpot Starter costs /month for 2 users, or /month for 10 users with Professional. HubSpot saves ,800/year for a 10-person team.

faqs.question: Can I migrate from HubSpot to Salesforce later?
faqs.answer: Yes, migration takes 2-4 weeks with data mapping, field customization, and team training. Use HubSpot's native Salesforce integration for a gradual transition. Budget ,000-15,000 for a consultant if needed.

faqs.question: Which CRM is better for startups with no sales team?
faqs.answer: HubSpot. Its free CRM works for founders doing their own sales. Contact management, deal tracking, and email templates are included. You don't need a dedicated sales team to get value from HubSpot.

description: HubSpot vs Salesforce for startups compared: free tier value, cost at 5/10/20 users, implementation time, and when to migrate from one to the other.
verdict: For startups, HubSpot wins. The free CRM is genuinely unlimited, setup takes hours not weeks, and marketing tools are included. Salesforce is overkill until you have 20+ sales reps and complex processes. Start with HubSpot Free. Graduate to HubSpot Pro (/mo) at Series A. Evaluate Salesforce only when you hit + ARR and need enterprise customization.
